pattern: Subject + did + not + use to + V1
en: The system didn't use to be so automated.

en: Did you use to arrive early for meetings?

en: The machine wouldn't start on cold mornings.

en: We used to discuss the project strategy daily.

pattern: Subject + used to + V1 + to + Object
